data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/1450Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA BECOMES A REMNANT LOW PRESSURE AREA. As of 3:00 PM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.4, -43.6 with movement E at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 01/0839Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL STRENGTHENING AS IT CONTINUES WEST-NORTHWESTWARD. As of 2:00 AM MST Thu Oct 01 the center of Rachel was located near 19.4, -109.3 with movement WNW at 6 mph. The minimum central pressure was 972 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 90 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 01/0842Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: DEPRESSION CONTINUES EASTWARD. As of 2:00 AM PDT Thu Oct 01 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 15.3, -124.6 with movement E at 14 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.
